title: Flat-module descent over a directed preorder in arbitrary cartesian models
statement: Let $I$ be a directed preorder and $R:I\to\mathrm{CommRing}$ a diagram of Noetherian rings. Let $c$ be a limiting cone on $R^{\mathrm{op}}\circ\operatorname{Spec}$, with affine vertex $S$ and projections $\pi_i:S\to\operatorname{Spec}(R_i)$. Fix $i\in I$, a finitely presented morphism $f:X_i\to\operatorname{Spec}(R_i)$ [def-pc-scheme, def-pc-morphism-conventions], and a finitely presented $\mathcal O_{X_i}$-module $M$ [def-sc-finitely-presented-module]. Suppose $a:X\to X_i$ and $b:X\to S$ form a cartesian square with $f$ and $\pi_i$ [def-pc-base-change], and $a^*M$ [def-pc-module-pullback] is flat over $S$ [def-pc-scheme-module-flat-over]. Then there are $j\ge i$ such that for every $k\ge j$ and every cartesian square $p:Y\to X_i$, $q:Y\to\operatorname{Spec}(R_k)$ over $f$ and the transition $\operatorname{Spec}(R_k)\to\operatorname{Spec}(R_i)$, the module $p^*M$ is flat over $\operatorname{Spec}(R_k)$ via $q$. No proper-support hypothesis or conclusion is imposed.

proof.text: Compare the assumed cartesian model with the canonical limit pullback and transfer relative flatness.
Apply one-stage preorder flat-module descent to get j >= i and flatness of the canonical pullback at j.

For k >= j pull the canonical stage-j module back along Spec(R_j -> R_k). Tensor pullback preserves finite presentation and thus quasi-coherence, so relative-flatness base change applies. Paste the two cartesian squares and use functoriality of R and Spec to identify the composite base transition. Tensor-pullback composition transports flatness to the direct composite pullback of M. Finally compare this cartesian model with the arbitrary given square p,q.

theorem exists_eventually_isFlatOver_of_isPullback_limit_preorder
    {I : Type u} [Preorder I] [IsDirected I (· ≤ ·)]
    (R : I ⥤ CommRingCat.{u}) [∀ k : I, IsNoetherianRing (R.obj k)]
    (c : Cone (R.op ⋙ Scheme.Spec)) (hc : IsLimit c) [IsAffine c.pt]
    (i : I) {Xi : Scheme.{u}} (f : Xi ⟶ Spec (R.obj i))
    [LocallyOfFinitePresentation f] [QuasiCompact f] [QuasiSeparated f]
    (M : Xi.Modules) [M.IsFinitePresentation]
    {X : Scheme.{u}} (a : X ⟶ Xi) (b : X ⟶ c.pt)
    (hcart : IsPullback a b f (c.π.app (op i)))
    (hflat : ((Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback a).obj M).IsFlatOver b) :
    ∃ (j : I) (hij : i ≤ j), ∀ (k : I) (hjk : j ≤ k)
      {Y : Scheme.{u}} (p : Y ⟶ Xi) (q : Y ⟶ Spec (R.obj k)),
      IsPullback p q f (Spec.map (R.map (homOfLE (hij.trans hjk)))) →
      ((Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback p).obj M).IsFlatOver q
